title: Business Enterprise, Creation & Management (Top-Up)
subject: Business
summary: Finish your degree while learning how to start, run and grow a business.
description: Ideal if you want to launch your own business or work in a start-up, this top-up covers entrepreneurship, innovation and management.
It turns your Level 5 qualification into an honours degree in one year.
entryRequirements: An HND, Foundation Degree or Level 5 Diploma in business or a related subject
